title: VARIATIONIST: Exploring Multifaceted Variation and Bias in Written Language Data

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating human annotator subjectivity by calculating the association (using normalized class relevance metrics) between annotators' self-reported sexual orientations and the specific lexical items (e.g., 'gay') they deem indicative of hate speech.

Evaluating human annotator subjectivity by calculating the association (using normalized class relevance metrics) between annotators' self-reported race and the specific lexical items (e.g., 'n*ggas') they rely on to label text as hate speech.
Measuring and visualizing the spatial distribution of specific lexical items across different regions and coordinates using pointwise mutual information (PMI) to uncover regional language variations.
